diagnostic.cause: Python 3.11 site.addpackage reads the UTF-8 editable .pth using the Windows CP936 locale; the project path contains Chinese characters and decoding fails.
diagnostic.evidence: The pth file decodes as UTF-8 in PowerShell; Python 3.11 locale.getencoding() reports cp936; Python 3.11 site.py uses encoding=locale while Python 3.13 site.py decodes .pth as utf-8-sig first.
diagnostic.workaround: For Python 3.11, install the built wheel non-editably from an ASCII-path temporary environment. The project .venv was restored to Python 3.13 and uv editable execution passed. No source workaround was added.

limitations: These are focused compatibility smoke tests, not the full Python 3.11/3.13 CI matrix.
